balance.finanzierungRegel: Reform costs plus the fiscal impulse after funding offsets: 130 basis points for each additional GDP point above 2. Interest and the base budget are not counted again here.
balance.fiskalstand: Reforms and the budget together require an additional {wert}% of GDP per year. Taxes and savings count as funding offsets. This is not the total budget deficit.
balance.zinsschritt: Catch-up phase: The bank can currently raise rates by up to {wert} percentage points per meeting because rates are far below inflation expectations. Higher rates take time to work; credit, investment and employment may suffer first.
balance.baulage: Administration: {vorrat} points available · monthly balance {saldo}. An exhausted reserve halves construction output. The balance is applied before the next construction step.
balance.personal: Already included in monthly administrative capacity: {wert} points from the staffing budget already in effect.
balance.baupause: Pause projects: capacity is freed, but a paused site loses {anteil} % of its building points every month. Abandoning a project forfeits the capital paid.
balance.bauprioritaet: Move a project up: {n} administrative capacity per place. Other projects then wait longer; an exhausted administration does not get stronger this way.
balance.baupersonal: Increase staffing: Each budget step costs 0.4% of GDP per year and raises base administrative capacity by 5% after implementation begins. It needs funding and political approval. Research, education and digital administration help over the longer term.
